title: Worker logs carry no query parameters, tokens or emails on D1 failure
acceptance: A safeErrorSummary(err) helper logs only the name and cause message for errors carrying query/params; app.onError and describeOAuthConnectFailure use it.
Better Auth uses onAPIError: { throw: true } so the sanitized Hono handler owns logging, covering better-call's SERVER_ERROR line.
Repro d2-quality-q01-reset-token-log reports tokenInLog=false for message and stack while the status stays 5xx; the unit repro shows no ciphertext sentinel; auth integration tests stay green.
Hashed verification identifiers are optional and, if adopted, ship with a note that links already sent stop working.
nextAction: Await owner Ready. Files: apps/api/src/index.ts, lib/auth.ts, provider routes. Owner-gated paths: the PR needs owner-approved.

evidence.summary: Proposed as packet 3 of the 2026-10-28 Claude audit at 4c344e2. Audit-only proposal; not reverified at intake.

AUD-003 (P3, confirmed on the mounted Worker): a D1 failure logs every bound value, including a live reset token, emails, password hashes and provider-token ciphertext. Repro and evidence files are listed in the audit package.
